frozen_dates.missed_deadline_state: EXPIRED_UNSTARTED; no rolling start, retrospective inclusion or date change; a new outcome-blind protocol is required

exact_user_supplied_prerequisites: For each source: scoped written acquisition authorization; permitted access/use and raw-evidence retention terms; actual account/provider entitlement including territory/market scope; measured quota and remaining capacity covering the frozen cadence, pagination and protocol request cap.

For OddsPapi/Pinnacle: subscribed plan evidence covering fixture and Pinnacle market access, plus actual quota consumption/remaining capacity; for TOTALbet, Lebull, GOLGG and Liquipedia: source-specific permission/retention/rate evidence; tenant IDs or unauthenticated reachability do not substitute.

For official unit/roster: exact authorized publisher/API/document URL(s), competition scope, source permission, and authentic registration/slot identity plus timestamped match-specific announced five, player-ID crosswalk, revision and capture/publication clocks.

For official actual-start/result: exact authorized event/start and result/settlement URL(s) per relevant scope; authoritative actual start distinct from schedule; result/correction publication and receipt evidence; settlement/void convention.

Authentic captured samples sufficient to verify exact source and fixture IDs, both quote sides/outcome bindings, stable schema, schedule revisions, clocks, source revision, and where relevant the distinct underlying bookmaker identity; do not send credentials or secret-bearing URLs in the evidence.

Measured capacity for two independent underlying approved bookmakers and all fixture-discovery/history/official-source calls; documented that TOTALbet and Lebull are not merely common-upstream duplicate pricing if both count as votes.

Live release-aware native inputs and opportunity ledger operated under the frozen protocol, followed by sealing required hashes/oracles and all readiness evidence before the deadline; separately authorize any later execution stage.
local_reachable_prerequisites: E1–E4 local evidence is already recorded as passing in the sealed decision; do not repeat the Plan09 proof.
The frozen protocol already defines exact-byte capture fields, probe caps, fixture selection, source roles, freshness and dates.
The named code contains local parsers/consumer schemas and an explicit native snapshot envelope path; none authenticates an external source.
external_vs_local_boundary: Authorization, retention permission, account entitlements, real quotas, official exact locators, genuine source samples, binding evidence and live operating proof require user/provider/official-source inputs. Local parser or contract changes cannot manufacture them.
source_scope_search_result: No later approval/locator was found in source_contracts.json or the contract-linked acquisition_requirements.json, sports_access_audit.json and quote_access_audit.json; no credentials/environment/full-filesystem search was done.
